profile.value_proposition: Raseed gets UAE trading companies paid faster: FTA-ready e-invoices, automatic reminders in Arabic and English, and a live view of who owes what.

pages./: Raseed. Get paid on time. Accounts receivable software built for UAE distributors and trading companies. Book a demo with our Dubai team.
pages./product: Send FTA-compliant e-invoices, chase overdue invoices automatically by email and WhatsApp in Arabic and English, and reconcile payments against your ERP. Integrates with Tally, Zoho Books and Odoo. Built for finance teams of 2 to 20 handling hundreds of credit customers. Most customers come to us when their overdue receivables pass sixty days or when e-invoicing becomes mandatory for them.
pages./customers: Trusted by trading companies across the Emirates. Al Noor Building Materials cut its days sales outstanding by a third. Gulfline Auto Parts chases four hundred credit accounts with one accountant. Deira Foodstuff Trading reconciles payments daily.
pages./pricing: Plans from AED 1,500 a month. Growth plan AED 4,500 a month. Enterprise from AED 12,000 a month. Raseed is not built for retailers selling to consumers or for sole traders.

ground_truth: UAE-based wholesalers, distributors and trading companies (building materials, auto parts, foodstuff, electronics, FMCG, industrial supplies) with roughly 20-500 staff that sell on credit to many business customers and have a finance or accounts team. Not software vendors, accounting firms, banks, payment providers or fintechs; not retailers selling only to consumers; not sole traders; not companies outside the UAE.
